public.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
public.description: Return whether every node of the binary tree satisfies strict binary-search ordering: all values in its left subtree are smaller, and all values in its right subtree are larger. Duplicates are invalid. The empty tree is valid. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: A node must obey every ancestor bound.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Carry an open lower and upper bound down the tree. O(n) time and O(h) traversal space.
